flowchart TD
  start["START"] --> gate["coach_gate"]
  gate -->|"valid cron wake"| reminder["reminder_delivery"]
  gate -->|"attachment"| claim["claim_document"]
  gate -->|"red flag injection or recall"| short["short_circuit"]
  gate -->|"erasure request"| erase["erase_my_data"]
  gate -->|"other question"| agent["coach_agent"]
  claim --> review["review_document interrupt"]
  reminder --> final["finalize"]
  short --> final
  erase --> final
  agent --> final
  review --> final
  final --> finish["END"]

flowchart TD
  Start["Graph input"] --> Gate["coach_gate scrubs and selects route"]
  Gate -->|"valid cron wake"| Deliver["reminder_delivery"]
  Gate -->|"attachment id"| Claim["claim_document"]
  Gate -->|"red flag injection or identifier recall"| Stop["short_circuit"]
  Gate -->|"erase request"| Erase["erase_my_data"]
  Gate -->|"all other turns"| Coach["coach_agent"]
  Claim --> Review["review_document interrupt and save decision"]
  Deliver --> Finalize["finalize_coach"]
  Stop --> Finalize
  Erase --> Finalize
  Coach --> Finalize
  Review --> Finalize
  Finalize --> Done["Safe CoachOutput"]

flowchart TD
  I["authenticated member input"] --> S["scrub and validate managed record"]
  I --> U["bounded upload reservation"]
  U --> R["scrubbed proposal and member review"]
  R --> P["profile facts or discard"]
  I --> M["reminder record and cron"]
  M --> W["verified wake and reminder card"]
  I --> F["feedback record and feedback service"]
  E["erasure request"] --> G["write erasing gate"]
  G --> X["remove crons reservations and stored namespaces"]
  X --> C["confirmation marker enables thread deletion"]

sequenceDiagram
  participant Client as Member client
  participant Authn as Authentication
  participant Boundary as Member perimeter
  participant Platform as Thread and run platform
  participant Graph as Coach graph
  Client->>Authn: authenticated request
  Authn->>Boundary: principal with identity
  Boundary->>Boundary: validate route and body
  Boundary->>Platform: owner-scoped operation
  Platform->>Graph: admitted input or resume
  Graph-->>Platform: state and interrupts
  Platform-->>Boundary: response
  Boundary-->>Client: projected public state

flowchart TD
  Start["incoming question"] --> Gate["safety_gate"]
  Gate -->|"refusal or deterministic direct response"| Finalize["finalize"]
  Gate -->|"tool decision required"| Decide["generate_query_or_respond"]
  Gate -->|"safe retrieval path"| Clarify["clarify_query"]
  Gate -->|"safe retrieval path"| Context["extract_conversation_context"]
  Decide -->|"direct response"| Finalize
  Decide -->|"retrieve"| Clarify
  Decide -->|"retrieve"| Context
  Clarify --> Decompose["decompose_query"]
  Context --> Decompose
  Decompose -->|"parent and capped subquery Sends"| Retrieve["retrieve_documents"]
  Retrieve --> Merge["merge_retrievals"]
  Merge -->|"initial retrieval"| Evaluate["evaluate_retrieval"]
  Merge -->|"gap fill merged"| Generate["generate_answer"]
  Evaluate -->|"one gap fill round"| Retrieve
  Evaluate -->|"otherwise"| Generate
  Generate --> Validate["validate_answer"]
  Validate -->|"validated"| FollowUps["generate_follow_ups"]
  Validate -->|"not validated"| Finalize
  FollowUps --> Finalize
  Finalize --> Done["END"]

flowchart TD
    Env["Environment variables"] --> Settings["GraphSettings from_env snapshot"]
    Settings --> Resources["Resources lazy owner"]
    Settings --> Engine["GraphEngine"]
    Resources --> Gateway["LangChainLLMGateway"]
    Gateway --> DefaultModel["Default model tier"]
    Gateway --> ValidatorModel["Validator model tier"]
    Engine --> Checkpoint["In-memory or SQLite checkpoint"]

flowchart TD
  Read["read root and local instructions"] --> Trace["trace owner callers state and focused tests"]
  Trace --> Change["make one bounded behavior change"]
  Change --> Focus["run focused offline check"]
  Focus --> Decide{"does a real boundary change"}
  Decide -->|"yes"| Widen["run appropriate real or contract loop"]
  Decide -->|"no"| Review["review diff and results"]
  Widen --> Compare["compare equivalent evidence"]
  Compare --> Review
  Review --> Docs["refresh wiki after structural change"]

flowchart TD
  Unit["focused deterministic test"] --> Offline["area suite or make test"]
  Offline --> Behavior{"model retrieval safety or user behavior changed"}
  Behavior -->|"yes"| Pipeline["named real evaluation"]
  Pipeline --> CrossTurn{"coach or cross-turn behavior"}
  CrossTurn -->|"yes"| Multi["multi-turn evaluation"]
  CrossTurn -->|"no"| Compare["compare equivalent artifacts"]
  Multi --> Compare
  Behavior -->|"no"| Contract{"server or deployed contract changed"}
  Contract -->|"yes"| Parity["parity or deployed smoke"]
  Contract -->|"no"| Record["record executed checks"]
  Compare --> Record
  Parity --> Record

flowchart TD
    Input["User message and history"] --> Scrub["Identifier sanitization"]
    Scrub --> Gate["Safety gate"]
    Gate --> Stop{"Terminal category"}
    Stop -->|"yes"| Template["Static refusal or redirect"]
    Template --> Finish["Scrubbed final result"]
    Stop -->|"no"| Pipeline["Retrieval, generation, validation"]
    Pipeline --> Finish

sequenceDiagram
  participant Browser as Member browser
  participant Supabase as Supabase
  participant Runtime as Next runtime route
  participant Deployment as Member deployment
  Browser->>Supabase: Get or refresh session
  Supabase-->>Browser: Access token
  Browser->>Runtime: AG-UI request with Bearer
  Runtime->>Deployment: GET addressed thread with same Bearer
  Deployment-->>Runtime: Accessible or denied
  Runtime->>Deployment: Forward runtime request with Bearer
  Deployment-->>Runtime: Agent events or SSE
  Runtime-->>Browser: Streamed AG-UI events

flowchart TD
    Source["Versioned dataset and evaluator inputs"] --> Sync["Stable-ID dataset sync"]
    Source --> Run["Real pipeline run"]
    Sync --> Run
    Run --> Score["Deterministic and optional judge scoring"]
    Score --> Artifact["JSON and Markdown report"]
    Artifact --> Compare["Comparison or gated decision"]
    Source --> Seal["Cleanliness and provenance checks"]
    Seal --> Compare

sequenceDiagram
    participant Caller
    participant Graph as GraphEngine
    participant Guard as Input hiding guard
    participant Smith as LangSmith
    participant Retrieve as Retrieval node
    Caller->>Graph: construct engine
    Graph->>Guard: enforce input hiding
    Guard-->>Graph: tracing enabled or disabled
    Caller->>Graph: run_turn question
    Graph->>Smith: root run with scrubbed question
    Graph->>Retrieve: execute retrieval
    Retrieve->>Smith: retriever child run
    Graph-->>Caller: finalized result and telemetry

flowchart TD
    Data["golden_dataset.json"] --> Sync["UUID5 dataset sync"]
    Sync --> Select["filter examples and metadata"]
    Select --> Harness["fresh thread and GraphEngine"]
    Harness --> Metrics["deterministic checks then optional judges"]
    Metrics --> Experiment["LangSmith experiment"]
    Experiment --> Report["evals/results JSON and Markdown"]
    Report --> Compare["comparison with declared constraints"]

flowchart TD
    Conversation["one dataset conversation"] --> Thread["fresh evaluation thread"]
    Thread --> First["first turn through GraphEngine"]
    First --> Later["later turns share thread state"]
    Later --> Record["turn records and trajectory"]
    Record --> TurnMetrics["per-turn mean and worst"]
    Record --> ConversationMetrics["conversation checks"]
    TurnMetrics --> Report["multi-turn report"]
    ConversationMetrics --> Report

flowchart TD
  Input["routing_gate CLI"] --> Mode{"fixture or smoke"}
  Mode -->|"yes"| Evidence["typed canned or fixture evidence"]
  Mode -->|"no"| StageOne["run every lane arm for stage 1"]
  StageOne --> ValidateOne["validate manifests and settings"]
  ValidateOne --> Screen["stage 1 evaluator"]
  Screen --> Second{"all stages and clean screen"}
  Second -->|"yes"| StageTwo["run every lane arm for stage 2"]
  StageTwo --> ValidateTwo["validate phase and cross-phase bindings"]
  ValidateTwo --> Evidence
  Second -->|"no"| Evidence
  Evidence --> Verdict["lane verdict evaluator"]
  Verdict --> Publish["transactional report batch for non-fixture runs"]

flowchart TD
  Tag["approved release tag"] --> Build["build and publish GHCR image"]
  Build --> Gate["production environment approval and policy audit"]
  Gate --> Secrets["stage runtime secrets in Fly"]
  Secrets --> Mirror["mirror source image and resolve Fly digest"]
  Mirror --> Deploy["deploy tagged config and immutable digest"]
  Deploy --> Ready["wait for readiness endpoint"]
  Ready --> Smoke["run deployed smoke gate"]
  Smoke -->|"pass"| Accepted["release accepted"]
  Smoke -->|"fail"| Red["deployment red and human decision required"]

flowchart TD
    Setup["Create local environment"] --> Vector["Start local Weaviate"]
    Vector --> Load["Load checked-in chunks"]
    Load --> Choose{"Choose local entrypoint"}
    Choose --> Cli["RAG CLI"]
    Choose --> Graph["LangGraph development server"]
    Choose --> Oss["OSS Agent Server"]
    Choose --> Web["Frontend development server"]
    Setup --> Checks["Run focused checks"]

stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> uninitialized
  uninitialized --> initializing : initialize
  initializing --> ready : build and validate
  initializing --> failed : any initialization error
  ready --> ready : scan
  failed --> failed : later initialize calls

flowchart TD
  Input["Incoming question and checkpoint history"] --> Gate["Safety gate scrubs question and history"]
  Gate --> Prompt["Scrubbed query and history prompts"]
  Prompt --> Retrieve["Scrubbed routed query to retrieval"]
  Retrieve --> Answer["Retrieved content and model generation"]
  Answer --> Output["Scrub generated and validated output"]
  Output --> Result["Monitor and result projection scrub output"]

flowchart TD
    Start["public graph input"] --> Gate["safety gate"]
    Gate -->|"refusal or direct reply"| Finalize["finalize"]
    Gate -->|"tool query arm"| QueryArm["query or respond"]
    Gate -->|"normal safe request"| Clarify["clarify query"]
    Gate -->|"normal safe request"| Context["extract conversation context"]
    QueryArm -->|"retrieve"| Clarify
    QueryArm -->|"retrieve"| Context
    QueryArm -->|"approved social direct reply"| Finalize
    Clarify --> Decompose["decompose and fan out"]
    Context --> Decompose
    Decompose --> Retrieve["retrieve documents"]
    Retrieve --> Merge["merge retrievals"]
    Merge --> Evaluate["evaluate retrieval"]
    Merge -->|"after gap fill"| Generate["generate answer"]
    Evaluate -->|"sufficient"| Generate
    Evaluate -->|"one gap fill round"| Retrieve
    Generate --> Validate["validate answer"]
    Validate -->|"validated"| FollowUps["generate follow ups"]
    Validate -->|"not validated"| Finalize
    FollowUps --> Finalize

flowchart TD
  Retrieved["retrieved documents"] --> Format["format documents with doc_N IDs"]
  Format --> Draft["generate scrubbed plain answer"]
  Format --> Structure["structure answer with citation metadata"]
  Draft --> SourceCheck["inspect raw markers and scaffold prefix"]
  Structure --> SourceCheck
  SourceCheck -->|"unsafe, absent, or mismatched"| Fallback["fixed fallback"]
  SourceCheck -->|"reconstructed source answer"| Resolve["resolve doc_N to original ID"]
  Retrieved --> QuoteCheck["locate document and check quote"]
  Resolve --> QuoteCheck
  QuoteCheck --> Render["remove failed citations and render"]
  Render --> Validated["validated state"]

flowchart LR
    Input["Routed collection and query"] --> Node["retrieve_documents"]
    Node --> Select["Select configured arm"]
    Select --> Weaviate["Weaviate hybrid search"]
    Select --> PageIndex["PageIndex tree and cached chunks"]
    Select --> Pinecone["Pinecone hybrid query"]
    Weaviate --> Result["QueryResultList"]
    PageIndex --> Result
    Pinecone --> Result
    Result --> Decision{"Reranker enabled"}
    Decision -->|"no"| Merge["union_results and downstream graph"]
    Decision -->|"yes"| Rerank["Pinecone rerank per collection"]
    Rerank --> Merge

sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant Gateway as LLM gateway
    participant Retrieve as retrieve_documents
    participant Weaviate
    participant Merge as merge_retrievals
    participant Answer as generation and validation
    User->>Retrieve: scrubbed query and branch metadata
    Retrieve->>Gateway: route to collection tools
    Gateway-->>Retrieve: query collection tool calls
    Retrieve->>Weaviate: hybrid search per routed collection
    Weaviate-->>Retrieve: objects with score and properties
    Retrieve->>Merge: retrieval envelope
    Merge->>Answer: deduplicated merged context

flowchart TD
    Pdf["Authorized source PDF"] --> Chunker["DocumentChunkProcessor"]
    Chunker --> Artifact["checked-in chunks JSON"]
    Artifact --> Review["Review IDs pages and chunk changes"]
    Review --> Rebuild["Delete and import collection"]
    Rebuild --> Check["Focused retrieval and evaluation"]
    Check --> Accept{"Expected recall and citations"}
    Accept -->|yes| Baseline["Record updated evaluation baseline"]
    Accept -->|no| Fix["Correct artifact schema or service issue"]
    Fix --> Rebuild

flowchart TD
  Input["User question and checkpointed messages"] --> History["Scrub and token-cap history views"]
  Input --> Boundary["Scrub query and check refusal boundaries"]
  Boundary -->|"matching boundary"| Final["Finalize fixed refusal"]
  Boundary -->|"no match"| Classify["Deterministic checks and structured LLM assessment"]
  Classify --> Decision{"Terminal decision"}
  Decision -->|"emergency advice injection out of scope"| Final
  Decision -->|"safe or ambiguous"| Prep["Clarify and context extraction"]
  Decision -->|"direct social or tool arm"| Query["Generate query or respond"]
  Prep --> Retrieve["Retrieval and generation"]
  Query --> Final
  Retrieve --> Final

flowchart TD
  Input["User question and checkpoint history"] --> History["Scrub history and create limited context"]
  Input --> Boundary["Scrub question and check stored refusal boundary"]
  Boundary -->|"matching refusal"| Final["Finalize fixed response"]
  Boundary -->|"no match"| Assess["Deterministic signals plus LLM assessment"]
  Assess --> Choice{"Terminal policy decision"}
  Choice -->|"emergency advice scope recall injection"| Final
  Choice -->|"informational or ambiguous"| Pipeline["Clarify retrieve generate validate"]
  Pipeline --> Final

flowchart TD
  Boot["python -m server"] --> Config["load config and create Starlette app"]
  Config --> Storage["create storage and set up saver and store"]
  Storage --> Recover["reconcile interrupted runs and due crons"]
  Recover --> Graphs["install compatibility shim and attach graphs"]
  Graphs --> Custom["enter custom app lifespan"]
  Custom --> Engine["create run engine and cron scheduler"]
  Engine --> Ready["all readiness checks true"]
  Ready --> Serve["serve requests"]
  Serve --> Stop["cancel scheduler and shut down run engine"]
  Stop --> Close["exit custom lifespan and close storage pool"]
